Laying this garden path simply can make the plain yard become more distinctive and warm. It is not only practical for walking, but also serves as a nice landscape ornament, greatly improving the overall aesthetic feeling of outdoor leisure space.

Its simple natural style will not destroy the original landscape layout of the yard at all. It plays a great role in dividing functional areas quietly and harmoniously. It matches all kinds of outdoor garden styles easily without any sense of incongruity.

We returned from Bali and my wife was dead set on getting a handpan after playing it overseas. Not wanting to spend the hundreds for something which may be a short term hobby I went with the 10 tone handpan from Vevor. My wife’s been happy with the purchase and for a novice we can’t really tell the difference between a more expensive one we played in Bali. She’s picked up some song from YouTube and enjoying the process. The tune may eventually turn sour but by then if she’s still playing, investing in something more expensive would make sense but for a first time player, this is really good value. Shipping was quick. We had ours in 2 days from ordering.
The two highest notes dont sing as well as the rest, but I bought this for the purpose of learning so it's great as a learning tool and it wont nuke your wallet. I love it so far and it's been fun
